title: Iteration 0 – Foundation
description: Production-ready technical base: monorepo, SvelteKit, DB, auth, PWA, CI, docs.

title: Iteration 1 – Room + Character
description: A simple living space with a placeholder character: idle, walk, sit, animation system.

title: Iteration 2 – Autonomous Activities
description: Sleep, eat, work, gaming; time, hunger, energy, mood; basic scheduler. The character acts without input.

title: Iteration 3 – Player Awareness
description: UNKNOWN/SUSPECTED/DETECTED/INTERACTING/IGNORING; the player can watch unnoticed.

title: Iteration 4 – Voice + Local LLM
description: Ollama, controlled decision schema, STT, TTS, subtitles, basic lip sync.

title: Iteration 5 – Memory + Relationship
description: Short-term, episodic, semantic and relationship memory with relevant retrieval.

title: Iteration 6 – Mobile Sensors
description: Orientation, motion, shake, mobile gravity, physical room reactions.

title: Iteration 7 – Rich Autonomous Life
description: Music, TV, cooking, cleaning, exercise, calls, shower, parties and more.

title: Iteration 8 – Emergent Moments
description: Behaviour combinations, embarrassment, contextual reactions, remembered awkward moments.

title: Iteration 9 – Economy
description: Job, income, expenses, budget, money entrusted to the player.

title: Iteration 10 – Shopping + Physical Progression
description: Shop; items arrive physically, get unpacked and used.

title: Iteration 11 – Career
description: Skills, opportunities, equipment requirements, autonomous career decisions.

title: Iteration 12 – Social World
description: Abstract NPCs: friends, coworkers, online friends, neighbours.

title: Iteration 13 – Dating
description: Attraction, dating, relationship development, breakups.

title: Iteration 14 – Physical NPC Visits
description: Selected NPCs visit physically; shared activities and conflicts.

title: Iteration 15 – Multiplayer Bridge
description: Paired players get a bridge; characters decide whether to cross.

title: Iteration 16 – Multi-device Physical Interaction
description: Characters walk between physically adjacent phones.

title: Iteration 17 – Parties and Group Interaction
description: Multiple NPCs in one household, each with own memory.

title: Iteration 18 – Partner
description: Partner as a persistent household member with own needs and goals.

title: Iteration 19 – Family
description: Shared household, children, changed priorities and finances.

title: Iteration 20 – Long-term Life Progression
description: Aging, moving, changing careers, relationships, goals and preferences.
